## Output
Systems, Focus and Node editor use the same admitted identities, registered schema and relations.

## Work
Replace the entire Systems path and delete its exclusive endpoint, schema, type identities, projections, tests, configuration and documentation. No fallback or compatibility path. Derive visible Instance of centrally from authoritative typeNodeId.

## Why one batch
Keeping both paths would preserve the route back into the same debt.

## Evidence
Focused behavior checks and rendered UI for orientation, filtering, selection, zoom and direct dependencies/dependents; complete checkpoint suite and a deletion audit. Show the before/after consumer dependencies.
